en.longDescription:
## Definition & Clinical Context

Malignant lymphoma is a malignancy of the lymphatic system, comprising Hodgkin lymphoma and the many non-Hodgkin lymphomas. In intensive care it is a comorbidity associated with immunosuppression and chemotherapy complications, and a cause of admission. Lymphoma is one of the chronic health items in the APACHE IV severity model.

## Scope

The set is anchored on the SNOMED concept *432571 / 118600007 — Malignant lymphoma* with all descendants included, so it captures Hodgkin and the full range of non-Hodgkin lymphoma subtypes.

## Mapping Notes

- Leukemia and multiple myeloma are distinct haematologic malignancies captured by their own sets.

versions.message: Vocabulary update: re-resolved against OMOP vocabulary v5.0 29-AUG-26 (previously v5.0 27-FEB-26). 459 -> 481 concepts. Added 60 (new or reclassified descendants in the new release): Marginal zone lymphoma of lymph nodes of pelvis (37469974); Marginal zone lymphoma of lymph nodes of upper limb (37469975); Mantle cell lymphoma of lymph nodes of pelvis (37469976); Mantle cell lymphoma of lymph nodes of lower limb (37469977); Mantle cell lymphoma of lymph nodes of upper limb (37469978); and 55 more. Removed 26 compound oncology concepts made non-standard by the OHDSI oncology remodelling: the diagnosis now maps to a standard concept already in the set, and the qualifier (stage, subtype, remission/relapse, genetic finding) to Cancer Modifier, Episode or OMOP Genomic. E.g. Non-Hodgkin's lymphoma in remission (603291); Adult T-cell leukemia/lymphoma in remission (604486); Follicular lymphoma grade 3b (606914); and 23 more. Removed 11 concepts made non-standard, mapping to a standard concept already in the set: Malignant lymphoma of lymph nodes of multiple sites (132841); Primary effusion lymphoma due to human immune deficiency virus infection (607384); Reticulosarcoma with AIDS (acquired immunodeficiency syndrome) (4226388); Primary lymphoma of brain with AIDS (acquired immunodeficiency syndrome) (4227969); Small lymphocytic B-cell lymphoma of lymph nodes of multiple sites (36684812); and 6 more. Removed 1 concept deprecated or made non-standard without any mapping: Tumor stage mycosis fungoides (4301662). 1 concept name updated by the vocabulary (e.g. 'Lymphoma of kidney' -> 'Malignant lymphoma of kidney').
